name: Woodworking Masters
old_description: At Wood Working Masters, we’re dedicated to redefining the art of woodworking with a commitment to excellence, innovation, and timeless craftsmanship. Founded on a passion for transforming raw materials into beautiful, functional works of art, our company stands at the forefront of custom woodworking and design.
about:
Woodworking Masters, a family-owned woodworking shop, was founded in 1996 in Pacoima, California. The business was established by the Aguirre family—Anthony Aguirre, Leo Aguinaga, and Antonio Aguirre—out of a passion for transforming raw lumber into custom architectural woodwork.

The company produces custom doors, stairs and balusters, and engineered wood veneers, supported by in-house shop milling services. Designs are developed using CAD software, and each piece undergoes a final inspection before delivery. The shop handles projects from concept through fabrication, though facility size and annual output are not disclosed.

Woodworking Masters serves homeowners, general contractors, and interior designers primarily in the Los Angeles area. Its work appears in residential construction and architectural millwork projects, where custom wood components are specified for both new builds and renovations.

The founders emphasize that every piece of wood has a story, and they cite over 30 years of combined craftsmanship as the foundation of their quality standards. The shop’s differentiation rests on material selection, attention to detail, and a design-to-build workflow that integrates CAD precision with hand-finished artistry.
type_evidence: Based in Los Angeles, CA, we are a family-owned Woodworking Shop that is dedicated to crafting custom handmade woodworks for our customers.
